about: Every property that makes a shot or a sequence, as a dimension the tool can set. Each dimension names its values and the field of the shot file (or the strategy, or look.json) it lands in. A director in directors.json is one value per dimension; a style on a take or a strategy pulls those values in as defaults. Precedence: strategy < style < take < the row's own fields (the row always wins). Where a dimension has no field yet, 'maps_to' says so; nothing is applied silently.

frame.what: where things sit in the picture

values.symmetric_centre: the subject and the line dead centre, left-right symmetric
values.thirds: subject on a third, horizon on a third
values.horizon_low: sky takes most of the frame
values.horizon_high: ground takes most of the frame
values.figure_small: the subject small against something vast
values.architecture_dominant: the built thing fills the frame; the event happens inside it
values.planimetric: flat-on, the camera square to the subject's face

frame.maps_to: take.look / take.look_h / take.el; checked by check (horizon row, subject position)

line.what: the camera's relation to the monument's axis (the 180-degree line)

values.on_axis: eye on the line, looking along it
values.oblique: off the line, looking across it
values.crossing: the move crosses the line (a statement)

values.drift: a move so slow it is noticed only at the end
values.walk: at walking pace at eye height

motion_curve.what: how a move starts and ends

values.hold_move_hold: still one second, eased move, still one second
values.constant: one speed, cut in and out of motion
values.ramp_to_instant: slows into the key instant, holds, releases

time.what: how time runs inside the shot

light.what: the Sun or Moon's height band, and its direction against the camera

direction.back: the body in front of the camera, subject in silhouette
direction.side: the body across the camera, relief shows
direction.front: the body behind the camera, flat light

light.maps_to: light.from / light.to as @moments; check (body in frame)

look.what: the display transform applied once per film to the rendered radiance. It changes no number the renderer computed; it is the film stock. Each value is recorded in look.json. Erick's ruling needed before any value but 'neutral' is used.

exposure.smooth: a curve from the Sun's altitude
exposure.auto: per frame (today; pumps at key instants)

look.maps_to: look.json (the look step after the renderer; not in the tool yet)

values.match: same shape or position as the previous shot

eye_trace.what: where the point of interest sits so the next cut lands where the eye already is

values.edge: at the frame's edge, about to leave or enter

sound.what: what is heard over the shot

voice.leads: starts 0.5 s before the picture it names

music.enters: a cue begins on the cut

silence.at_instant: no voice, music down across the key instant

sound.maps_to: voice; music (sound.json, not in the tool yet)

ladder.what: the order of rungs inside an act

values.jump: wide straight to close, nothing between
values.flat: all one rung (a montage of equals)

rhythm.what: the series of shot lengths; the pulse

values.accelerating: shorter toward the climax, then one long

values.axis_both_ways: the same line, summer then winter
values.rule_of_three: a figure shown three times, the third changed

act_shape.what: how an act enters and leaves

values.bookend: ends on the frame it began with

key_instant.what: how the climax of a claim is handled

values.ramp_hold_release: slow in, hold at the second, let go
values.pass_without_comment: the instant happens inside a long take
values.cut_to_it: arrive on the instant from another shot

colour_arc.what: how the look moves across the film

values.follow_the_day: warm at the ends, cool at night, neutral at noon (the physics gives this already)
values.toward_cold: warms to cools as the film goes

colour_arc.maps_to: look.json per act (not in the tool yet)

sound_arc.what: how voice and music are distributed

values.voice_sparse: a line per claim, silence between
values.silence_then_music: the first act silent, music enters with the first claim
